notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); this package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null), no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed.

WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[1], unitree_go1/scene_torque.xml, as a MujocoDriver in simulated mode R0. The card's models[0] is scene_position.xml; this package serves the torque scene because the upstream Go1MujocoEnv constructor defaults ctrl_type to 'torque' and builds scene_{ctrl_type}.xml (go1_mujoco_env.py:32-33), and its action comment is 'Action: 12 torque values' (go1_mujoco_env.py:119). This is a model choice inside the card's models, not a helper deviation: the family-config decision and the MujocoDriver helper express the model. cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [12 numbers]}}; every ctrl element is checked by the bridge against the model's actuator_ctrlrange (the global motor default is ctrllimited true, ctrlrange -1.0 1.0 at go1_torque.xml:7) before data.ctrl is written, then mj_step runs ticks times. cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults with mj_resetData + mj_forward. The state is the bridge's integration state (time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed); the model is a free trunk plus 12 hinge joints (19 qpos, 18 qvel). The card's other models (scene_position, go1_position, go1_torque) are not served by this package; changing model_path and facts serves another one.

WHY THIS SHAPE: MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is this package's stand-in mujoco module in fake.py, declared as the class object FakeMujoco. The stand-in parses the same scene and its include for the model shape: 12 motors with their control ranges, the trunk free joint plus 12 hinge joints, and the option timestep (the model states no timestep; go1_mujoco_env.py:37 states dt = 0.002 s for this scene). Its integration is a placeholder torque response, not MuJoCo's physics; it loads no mesh, texture or sensor and resolves no contact, constraint, gravity, inertia or actuator dynamics. The fidelity gaps list every difference. The sim path (a backend name backends does not list, which imports the real mujoco module and loads the same scene) was not run. The model file is read from the read-only clone at run time and is never copied into the package or imported.

LICENSE: the card pins license_spdx NOASSERTION with license_class unknown and the top-level clone has no LICENSE file; the model subdirectory unitree_go1/LICENSE is BSD-3-Clause (unitree_go1/README.md:27). The lock keeps the card's NOASSERTION because the card decides the pinned value; the model's own license is recorded as a fact, not substituted for the repository's.

WARNINGS (all expected, none failed): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco module rather than a package class the gate can wrap in a Recorder; G8.NO_UNIT x3 for ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed, the numeric inputs the simulator family derives. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised.

NOT COVERED: MuJoCo itself was never imported, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine; the upstream Go1MujocoEnv reinforcement-learning loop (frame_skip=10, 15 s episodes, home-keyframe reset with 0.1 noise, rewards and the 50 Hz action rate) is not served; the position-control scene and the training/rendering stacks are not part of this driver; no physical Go1 is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware. No catalogue_requests: the package uses only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1, both catalogue classes. There are no operator-required limits, so no site-limits.example.json is needed: the entire step envelope is derived from the loaded model.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver and adds seven cases (model shape from the scene, control-range and wrong-length refusals with zero effect, per-actuator step integration, reset defaults, ticks schema bound, published fidelity contract, e-stop latch); G9 passed within the gate.
